title: Value change under decrement
statement: For every Boolean word $u$, if its fixed-width decrement reports success, then the value of the resulting word plus one equals the value of $u$; if it reports failure, then the value of $u$ is zero.
replaced:
For every Boolean word $u$ read as a little-endian counter: if the fixed-width decrement
of $u$ reports success then the value of the decremented word plus one equals the value
of $u$, and if it reports underflow then the value of $u$ is zero.
